manifest.freeze: Root reviews the CPU-only fresh probe, then deliberately sets FROZEN status and pins resulting SHA; runner requires that exact SHA. No automatic unreviewed freeze.
records: Exact wheel URL/SHA/size/version and installed actual package origins/hashes.
Base six distributions unchanged versions/module origins/hashes/distribution roots; Python/platform/TorchCUDA/CXX11 ABI unchanged.
Complete installed target file SHA inventory excluding bytecode.
Logical four vendor bindings with actual owner attributes, owner/vendor source hashes, actual callable module and exact implementation object identity.
Read-only HF closure resolution records required is_new_implementation flags where applicable; direct actual vendor identity permitted without wrapper.
Fresh runtime proof finishes before model_loads_started increments. Repeat vendor object/closure proof after load and after each returned call.
API commit and exact old v8 input pack hash bound to this diagnostic.

private: Full source/request/old cached response/new raw/state packs
Runtime origins/installed files/wheel artifacts and full timing/output-size report

purpose: Separate optional-runtime diagnostic after the untouched v8 trial failed before any returned raw. No retry of that root.
readout: Persist every returned raw/typed Response immediately before strict core admission. Started and returned calls are separate durable counters.
Core individual candidate/state only; private reload forbids engine/compiler/authors and compares exact artifact. No map/normal ensure/HTTP/API/DB calls.
Strict rejected stop outputs remain diagnostic outcomes; never repair, relabel or retry. Length/late/process failure preserves all prior raw and partial checkpoint in a new ZIP.
Retain full pack/messages/fields and all raw/state/phase timing/output sizes privately for complete source and field-reading review.
Public aggregate contains only fixed enums/booleans/counts/integer ordinals/hashes. No raw text, origin paths, automatic timing ratio or quality rate.

New v7 precedes v8 and output lengths may differ; warm/JIT/cache/order effects prevent a general speed multiplier or model-quality claim. Exact vendor bindings do not by themselves prove every CUDA branch executed.
remaining_before_execution: Root installs only the isolated target and runs fresh CPU binding probe
Root reviews actual module origins/closure/vendor proof and freezes exact manifest hash
Jupyter CPU prepare with frozen manifest and exact API/source roots

runtime.causal_version_rule: Pin base1.7.0 and exact official wheel SHA; record and verify the actual installed distribution string including any local suffix.
runtime.fla_namespace: Both fla-core and flash-linear-attention0.6.0 are required: official HF v5.19 maps fla to full flash-linear-attention distribution metadata. Install them together; shared namespace collisions must be byte-identical.
runtime.installation: One pip transaction --no-deps --no-index --only-binary=:all: --no-compile --target NEW_ROOT with four fixed local wheels. No global upgrades.
runtime.installation_owner: Separate reviewed optional_kernel_install.py, never the diagnostic runner.
runtime.pythonpath: Fresh generation subprocess PYTHONPATH is exactly the reviewed target; API paths are injected by the unchanged read-only trial helper.
